companyType: Life-science / healthcare investment firm (venture + public markets)
mission: Transform the future of health by funding and building medicines and healthcare technologies — TechAtlas associates specialize in therapeutic landscapes to guide investment and portfolio strategy.

featured.description: Boston-based associate role collaborating with RA Capital’s Investment Team to evaluate biotech/life-science companies and competitive landscapes and advise portfolio-company program strategy (Greenhouse job 4565087008).
featured.responsibilities: Develop expertise across therapeutic areas/technologies; meet companies to evaluate investment opportunities; analyze preclinical/clinical datasets; conduct diligence with the Investment Team; communicate written/oral recommendations; work with portfolio companies on strategy and pipeline prioritization; interview KOLs; attend scientific/investor conferences; maintain and update competitive landscapes using RA Capital’s proprietary mapping system; assess inbound opportunities.
featured.qualifications: PhD in the biological sciences or MD required; 2–5 years consulting, investment banking, and/or fund (or related) experience; authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship; based in Greater Boston with hybrid commute to the Boston office. Skills: rapid learning of new science, critical analysis of preclinical/clinical data, experience leveraging AI, clear written/oral communication (theses, decks, presentations).

mission: Invent and build platform companies that change human health and sustainability by originating ventures from foundational biology and technology hypotheses (not a traditional passive VC model).

featured.description: Full-time Origination Associate helping ideate, pressure-test, and co-lead early company creation at Flagship — from scientific thesis and IP through early team building (Greenhouse job 8885168002).
featured.responsibilities: Explore white spaces in biology/technology; generate and stress-test venture hypotheses (conceptual, computational, or prototype-driven); design venture blueprints (technical thesis, experimental planning, product architecture, potential GTM); contribute hands-on to conceiving and launching ventures; collaborate across scientists, product thinkers, and entrepreneurs; synthesize complex information into actionable insights for Flagship’s venture-creation process.
featured.qualifications: Advanced degree (PhD or equivalent experience) in a scientific field — particularly biology, bioengineering, chemistry, or related disciplines; curiosity/creativity and drive to create companies (not only products); comfort with technical and business uncertainty; strategic thinking about value creation in biotechnology. Confirm full criteria on the live Greenhouse posting.

mission: Apprentice early-career scientists and technologists into Flagship’s company-creation process (“polyintelligence”: pairing human scientific creativity with AI) to generate pioneering venture hypotheses.

featured.description: Full-time, in-person summer fellowship (June 7–August 27, 2027) in Kendall Square for early-career scientists, technologists, engineers, and physicians; applications due December 15, 2026 (Greenhouse job 8721195002).
featured.responsibilities: Work in teams to generate novel scientific/technology concepts that challenge dogma; iterate hypotheses using scientific instinct plus AI tools; shape ideas into venture-ready theses; network with Flagship associates, partners, and ecosystem leaders; explore full-time pathways into Flagship Labs origination, Pioneering Intelligence, or Flagship-founded companies after the program.
featured.qualifications: Early-career scientists, technologists, engineers, or physicians with deep expertise in a scientific/technical field; available full-time in Cambridge, MA (55 Cambridge Parkway) for June 7–August 27, 2027; expected availability for potential full-time employment after the fellowship. Stipend provided. Apply by December 15, 2026.

mission: Back bold bio and healthcare entrepreneurs building the future of medicine and health technology across seed through growth stages.

featured.description: Bay Area communications partner for the a16z Bio + Health Fund amplifying portfolio-company stories and shaping narratives around late-stage bio/health technology (Greenhouse job 7998862003).
featured.responsibilities: Partner with General Partners/investment team on communications strategy; advise dozens of portfolio companies on brand, media, crisis, and internal communications; develop high-impact earned-media campaigns (press, trade, podcasts, newsletters); maintain media/influencer relationships; secure brand-building opportunities that win attention from leading founders and executives.
featured.qualifications: Minimum ~10 years corporate/executive/product/crisis communications experience with meaningful biotech, pharma, or healthcare background; deep familiarity with bio/healthcare landscape, media, and clinical/regulatory milestone rhythms; in-house and agency experience; strong national and healthcare media relationships; PR campaign leadership for high-growth companies; crisis communications experience. Role located in the San Francisco Bay Area.

companyType: Nonprofit tough-tech incubator / founder ecosystem (public-benefit organization)
mission: Help Tough Tech founders solve pressing challenges in climate, health, and advanced systems via programs, shared labs/infrastructure, and a national partner network.

featured.description: Full-time Cambridge, MA associate supporting The Engine’s Directors of Partnerships and Philanthropy on prospecting, executing, and stewarding strategic industry and philanthropic relationships (~$65k–$80k; posted on MIT Orbit).
featured.responsibilities: Identify and execute philanthropic and industry partnership opportunities; steward existing partner relationships; facilitate connections between Tough Tech founders and industry/philanthropic partners; support prospecting, materials, tracking, and follow-through that create tangible opportunities for The Engine’s ~160+ company community.
featured.qualifications: 2–3 years relevant experience in partnerships, business development, philanthropy/nonprofit development, program management, or related work. Preferred: fundraising/grants, startups/accelerators, corporate innovation, tech commercialization/tech transfer, consulting, scientific/engineering research, or Tough Tech sectors (climate, biotech, advanced manufacturing, robotics, computing, materials).

mission: Use data-driven and AI systems to turn unstructured healthcare, scientific, and financial information into decision-relevant insights that inform investment and portfolio processes.

featured.description: Hands-on IC role on RA Capital’s Healthcare Data Strategy / applied AI team designing systems that transform unstructured scientific and financial information into structured insights for investment professionals (Greenhouse job 5427346008).
featured.responsibilities: Design and build AI systems that convert unstructured healthcare/scientific/financial information into structured, usable insights; partner with investment professionals to turn ambiguous questions into technical solutions; own projects from problem definition through deployment and ongoing improvement across portfolio management, risk, and data-science use cases.
featured.qualifications: Strong applied AI / ML background working with unstructured data; ability to deliver in a fast-paced collaborative environment with Invest, Venture, Legal, Finance, Compliance, and TechAtlas partners. Confirm degree, years of experience, work-authorization, and Boston hybrid requirements on the live posting.
